name: Verba

legacy_logo_gradient.note: secondary gradient accents seen on the app icon/mark; dose sparingly, not part of the core UI palette

colors.notes: Dark is the default theme (color-scheme: dark; no data-theme attribute needed), light is opt-in via [data-theme=light]. Discipline: near-black monochrome + broken-white foreground. --accent (#f4ede0, warm off-white) is the ONLY signature accent and is used sparingly (a handful of times per screen). --rec (#ff5a4d dark / #e23b2e light) is the ONE living, saturated color on the whole site: the recording/listening dot. It also lives subliminally in panel shadow tints. Never let more than one vivid color appear per visual.

type.mono_family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
type.notes: SF Pro / Apple system-font stack with Inter fallback. No exotic or decorative typefaces. Mono family reserved for code-like / structured UI elements (keystroke labels, timestamps), never for brand wordmark.

voice.register: confident, candid, a little witty; pro-user, never salesy; Apple-native taste (macOS-feeling, Liquid Glass aesthetic, not enterprise SaaS)
voice.person: second-person direct address (you/your), first-person plural for the product (we build, it does)
do: short declarative sentences, active voice ("Speak it. Send it clean.")
name the concrete outcome, not the mechanism ("clean, structured, ready to send" not the tool that produced it)
confirm-gated language for JARVIS ("asks before it acts," "shows you exactly what it will do," "only acts once you confirm")
on-device / private framing for anything about where audio and text are processed (never the word cloud)
concrete numbers when real (1,000+ connected apps, roughly 3x faster than typing)
dont: Parakeet, Qwen, Whisper, Claude, Claude Code, Anthropic, GPT, OpenAI, or any other underlying model/vendor name
the word cloud in any context (say the audio and text stay on the Mac / on-device)
reuse your AI / pay twice / bring your own key framing
leverage, unlock, revolutionary, next-gen, synergy, enterprise jargon
em dash or en dash punctuation anywhere in copy
invented metrics or unverified claims; use [to confirm] when a number is not sourced
hard_rules: Never name the underlying listening/dictation/AI tech (no Parakeet, Qwen, Whisper, Claude, Claude Code, Anthropic, GPT, OpenAI); never a reuse-your-AI / pay-twice / bring-your-own mechanic; never the word cloud (say data stays on the Mac).
Keep JARVIS as the confirm-gated action feature name.
Zero em dash and en dash anywhere.
No invented metrics; use [to confirm] if unknown.

source: site: https://verba.run (homepage HTML + /_next/static/css/f3e14bb1fb4e0c59.css, fetched live) + /manifest.webmanifest; cross-checked against marketing/03-visual-identity/DA.md and .agents/product-marketing.md (Brand Voice section)
